hints.title: Prefix Sum Candy Indices
hints.text: Compute prefix sums of candiesCount to determine the 1-indexed range of candies belonging to each type.

hints.title: Calculate Min and Max Candies Consumed
hints.text: By day target_day + 1, you eat at least target_day + 1 candies and at most (target_day + 1) * daily_cap candies.

hints.title: Interval Overlap Check
hints.text: Check if consumption range [target_day + 1, (target_day + 1) * daily_cap] overlaps with candy type index range.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def canEat(self, candiesCount: list[int], queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[bool]:
        n = len(candiesCount)
        pref = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(n):
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + candiesCount[i]

        ans = []
        for fav_type, fav_day, daily_cap in queries:
            min_candies = fav_day + 1
            max_candies = (fav_day + 1) * daily_cap
            type_start = pref[fav_type] + 1
            type_end = pref[fav_type + 1]
            ans.append(not (max_candies < type_start or min_candies > type_end))
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating day-by-day eating for each query takes O(q * day) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix sums enable O(1) interval containment check per query using 64-bit integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses 64-bit prefix sums to prevent integer overflow when multiplying day and dailyCap.
